text.p: Tropical Cyclone Freda, with 65 mph winds, is southwest of the Fiji Islands in the southern Pacific near 23s/176e, moving south southeast at 7 mph. Freda is expected to weaken and remain southwest of Fiji during the next 36 hours, threatening only shipping.

Tropical Cyclone Gretelle, with 50 mph winds, is in the southern Mozambique Channel near 26s/38e, moving southwest at 6 mph. Gretelle is expected to turn more to the south but strengthen slightly during the next 24 hours, threatening shipping.
Tropical Cyclone Pancho-Helinda, with 75 mph winds, is nearly stationary in the southern Indian Ocean near 15s/90e. It is expected to remain nearly stationary, weakening, but threatening shipping.

Tropical Cyclone Iletta, with 60 mph winds, is in the southern Indian Ocean near 16s/71e, moving south southeast at 5 mph, and is expected to maintain strength and track slowly southward this period, threatening shipping.
There are no further statements at this time.
